headline: HII Declares Quarterly Dividend
summary: NEWPORT NEWS, Va., July 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- HII (NYSE: HII) announced today that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $1.38 per share, payable on Sept. 11, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on Aug. 28, 2026.
